# Set up

This section will describe all set up instructions required to run the single cell analyses.  

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(msigdbr)
library(here)
```


## Data

To run the analyses, you will first need to download the source data. The data can be found at two locations: NCBI GEO repository and the Broad Institute's Single Cell Portal.  

## More Data

We'll also be using some signatures from the Molecular Signatures Database. We'll generate that here.

```{r}
#| cache: true

h_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "H")
h_df %>%
    group_by(gs_name) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = gs_name,
                names_from = rank,
                values_from = gene_symbol,
                values_fill = "") %>%
    write_tsv(here("data", "signatures", "h_mouse.gmt"),
              col_names = NA)
```


## Paths

For the entirety of the single cell analysis, we'll use the following path variables and definitions, which will be called by sourcing the `setup.R` script in `lib/`

```{r}
#| message: false

data_dir <- here("data")
seq1_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "cellranger_output_seq1")
seq2_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "cellranger_output_seq2")
```


## Mouse-Human gene homologs

For some signature analyses, we'll need to convert between human and mouse homologs easily. I don't want to have to access the biomaRt servers constantly, so let's just download a data frame with the conversions. 

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(here)
library(biomaRt)
source(here("lib", "helper.R"))

mouse_human_df <- run_or_readRDS(
  here("data", "mouse_human_genes.rds"),
  function() {
    so <- readRDS(here("results", "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds"))
    
    hmart <-
      useMart("ensembl",
              dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl",
              host = "https://dec2021.archive.ensembl.org/")
    mmart <-
      useMart("ensembl",
              dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl",
              host = "https://dec2021.archive.ensembl.org/")
    
    mgenes <- rownames(so)
    
    mouse_human_genes <-
      getLDS(
        attributes = c("mgi_symbol"),
        mart = mmart,
        values = mgenes,
        attributesL = c("hgnc_symbol"),
        martL = hmart,
        verbose = TRUE
      )
  }
  )
```
